    crossings = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]
    line_color = Counter(v for row in crossings for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special = {(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(crossings) for j, v in enumerate(row)

def _dominant(values):
    return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]

def _minority(values):
    counts = Counter(values)
    # Grid rulings are the less frequent of the two dominant row/column colors.
    return min(counts, key=lambda color: (counts[color], color))

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_colors = [_dominant(row) for row in grid]
    col_colors = [_dominant(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    line_color = _minority(row_colors)
    vertical_line_color = _minority(col_colors)
    line_rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_colors) if color == line_color]
    line_cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_colors) if color == vertical_line_color]
    crossings = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]
    background = _dominant(v for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row_colors[r] != line_color for v in row)
    specials = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(crossings) for j, value in enumerate(row)
                if value != line_color and value != background]
    r0 = min(i for i, _ in specials)
    r1 = max(i for i, _ in specials)
    c0 = min(j for _, j in specials)
    c1 = max(j for _, j in specials)
    output = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = (crossings[i][j], crossings[i][j + 1],
                       crossings[i + 1][j], crossings[i + 1][j + 1])
            out_row.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 else background)
        output.append(out_row)
    return output
